# hpe_morpheus_library_file_template (Resource)

Manages a Morpheus Library File Template resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hpe_morpheus_library_file_template" "example" {
  name           = "Nginx Config"
  file_name      = "nginx.conf"
  file_path      = "/etc/nginx"
  template_phase = "provision"
  template       = file("/path-to-file")
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `file_name` (String) The file name of the template.
- `name` (String) The name of the library file template.

### Optional

- `category` (String) The category of the library file template.
- `file_path` (String) The file path of the template.
- `labels` (List of String) The labels of the library file template.
- `setting_category` (String) The setting category.
- `setting_name` (String) The setting name.
- `template` (String) The template content.
- `template_phase` (String) The phase of the template.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The ID of the library file template.

## Import

Import is supported using the resource ID.

```bash
terraform import hpe_morpheus_library_file_template.example 123
```
